{{Quote|You know why we're here.|translated=1|Dud Bolt, confronting Watto|<ref name="KSW" />}}
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''Trandoshan''' served as backup for the [[Vulptereen/Legends|Vulptereen]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] and [[Podracer/Legends|Podracer]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Dud Bolt/Legends|Dud Bolt]]. After losing the [[Outer Rim Regional Podracing Circuit]] to an amateur [[Team Watto pilot|pilot]], Bolt, the Trandoshan, and [[Unidentified Trandoshan (stun baton)|another]] [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]], confronted the pilot and his [[Team Watto|team]] leader, [[Watto/Legends|Watto]] on the planet [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]]. When Watto attempted to talk the trio off, the other Trandoshan used a [[Stun baton/Legends|stun baton]] to knock the [[Toydarian/Legends|Toydarian]] down. Before they could advance on the pilot, the [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] wielding Trandoshan was knocked unconscious when the [[Nosaurian/Legends|Nosaurian]] pilot [[Clegg Holdfast/Legends|Clegg Holdfast]] threw a folded [[DUM-series pit droid/Legends|DUM-series pit droid]] at him. Before his partner could react, he was similarly knocked down with a pit droid. Bolt drew a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] on Holdfast, but was disarmed and beaten. Bolt retreated, while the pit droids sat on the unconscious Trandoshans.<ref name="KSW" />
